earnings.title: Atlassian Announces First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Results
highlights: Cloud revenue of $1,302 million, up 31% year-over-year
Revenue: Total revenue was $1,772 million for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, up 24% from $1,433 million for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.

Operating Income (Loss) and Operating Margin: Operating income was $189 million for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, compared with operating loss of $96 million for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.
GAAP operating margin of 11% and non-GAAP operating margin of 32%

quotes.text: Q1 was a strong start to fiscal 2027, with RPO up 44% and Teamwork Collection customers up 7x year-over-year.
quotes.by: Mike Cannon-Brookes, Atlassian’s CEO and Co‑Founder

quotes.text: Subscription ARR grew 23% year-over-year and Cloud revenue grew 31% year-over-year, carrying forward our strong momentum across our strategic priorities of Enterprise, AI, and the System of Work.

outlook: Total revenue is expected to be in the range of $1,825 million to $1,835 million.
Cloud revenue growth year-over-year is expected to be approximately 27.0%.
Data Center revenue growth year-over-year is expected to decline approximately (14.0%).
Marketplace and other revenue growth year-over-year is expected to be approximately 20.0%.

items.heading: Our historical rapid growth makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects, and we may not be able to sustain our revenue growth rate or achieve long-term profitability in the future.
The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our business, results of operations, and financial condition could be harmed.
Our AI offerings and investments may not be successful, which could adversely affect our business or financial results.
We may encounter challenges as we continue to transition our business to focus on Cloud offerings.

Our business depends on our customers renewing their subscriptions and purchasing additional licenses or subscriptions from us, and any decline in our customer retention or expansion could harm our future results of operations.

If we are unable to develop or package new apps, agents and enhancements to our existing offerings that achieve market acceptance and that keep pace with technological developments, our business and results of operations could be harmed.
